events.title: 애스턴 빌라 sign midfielder Neale Cooper from Aberdeen for £350,000.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 are saved from bankruptcy after Wolverhampton Council and the Asda supermarket chain agree to pay off the club's £3million debts.
데이비드 시먼 , goalkeeper at relegated 버밍엄 시티 , opts to remain in the First Division and signs for 퀸스 파크 레인저스 for £225,000.

Rival gangs of 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 hooligans are involved in violence on a Sealink ferry bound for Amsterdam , resulting in dozens of arrests, sparking fears that the ongoing ban on English football clubs in European competition could be extended to friendlies between English and foreign clubs.
셰필드 웬즈데이 pay £200,000 for 18-year-old 반즐리 striker David Hirst .
The first Merseyside derby of the season finishes honours even, in the 1986 FA Charity Shield at Wembley Stadium .
토트넘 홋스퍼 sign 던디 유나이티드 and Scotland defender Richard Gough for £700,000.
에버턴 pay a club record £1million to sign the 24-year-old 노리치 시티 defender Dave Watson .

On the first day of the First Division season, 윔블던 's first match in the top division ends in a 3–1 defeat to 맨체스터 시티. 사우샘프턴 record the biggest win of the day, 5–1 against 퀸스 파크 레인저스. Champions 리버풀 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 2–0, and 아스널 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0. Colin Clarke scores a hat-trick for 사우샘프턴 on his debut in a 5–1 home win over QPR.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 win 3–2 at 맨체스터 유나이티드, with Frank McAvennie scoring twice.
루턴 타운 ban away fans from the club's Kenilworth Road ground.

토트넘 홋스퍼 go top of the First Division on goal difference with a 1–0 home win over 맨체스터 시티. They are level on points with 리버풀, who beat 아스널 2–1 at Anfield , and 웨스트햄 유나이티드, who are held to a goalless draw at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are still looking for their first point of the season after losing 1–0 at home to 찰턴 애슬레틱.

토트넘 홋스퍼 finish August as First Division leaders under new manager David Pleat , level on points with 리버풀 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드, while the bottom two places in the league are occupied by 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라, who have yet to gain a point this season. 버밍엄 시티 and 헐 시티 occupy the top two places in the Second Division, while the next three places are occupied by 올덤 애슬레틱 , 크리스털 팰리스 and 블랙번 로버스 .
